summary: Allied Gold Corp filed a Form 6-K announcing receipt of regulatory approvals for its acquisition by Zijin Gold International, including ICA clearance and ECOWAS/COMESA merger clearance, with certain African host-country approvals obtained or in advanced stages. The transaction is an all-cash acquisition of all outstanding common shares, with the outside date extended to July 29, 2026. The board is not explicitly recommending in this filing, but prior arrangement agreement implies recommendation. Structurally, the credit facility was amended to facilitate closing. What to watch / risk-arb angle: focus on remaining African regulatory approvals and any further outside date extensions; deal spread should reflect residual regulatory risk.
